capture_mode_statement: GAMEPLAY: real click → pointer lock → keyboard/mouse input. Frames after a failed phase (if any) are labelled STAGED.
render_mode_statement: ONDEMAND: the page simulates every animation tick but rasterises only at capture time (software GL pacing). Same renderer/scene/camera as play; wall-clock pacing differs.

frames.intent: spawn: shed doorway, route read toward the parapet opening
look-around east: adjacent office tower, tank farm, container yard depth layers
look-around west: mill, silos, harbour inlet depth layers
speed frame: roof run toward the parapet opening, annex and gallery visible
transition: landing on the annex, Kinetic Permit kiosk and gallery mouth
interior: inclined gallery, conveyor, ducts to slide under, lamps
branch read: WEST SHAFT / EAST SPAN signs, boiler house, relay yard above
dash gap read: torn conveyor, stub deck, hazard paint
vertical: container mantle chain up to the boiler roof
landmark: relay yard, stacks, pipe rack, header tank
vista: harbour cranes, estuary bridge, lower yard
vertical/relay: rack platform over the pipe rack, relay panel, stack platform beyond
low maintenance corridor: slide ducts, trusses, drop-room door
transition: framed drop shaft, yellow frame, landings visible below
interior arrival: turbine casings, crane rails, trolley, lit windows
transition: south gallery toward the loading door and the sunlit gantry
exterior vista: gantry over the quay, harbour cranes, ships, bridge, missing panel
final approach: crane cab, beacon, SUNLINE EXIT sign
finish look-back: whole route silhouette (turbine hall, boiler house, dispatch)

final_probe.objective: Cross the Sunline gantry to the crane cab. Dash or double-jump the missing panel.

scene_audit.required_human_review: Judge repetition/dead zones/placement from player-height frames. Counts cannot approve anything.
